name: Survey tile in Sagittarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Sagittarius, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 23 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 23 hours starting 2025-10-04, at wavelengths from 1.22 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
